officers.name: Jawad Zaza
officers.bio: Jawad is a mechanical engineering student and Co-President leading club operations and the CUASC drone team. He's passionate about hands-on design and helping members turn classroom concepts into real projects. His vision for AEC is a space where every student, regardless of experience, has room to build, compete, and grow.

officers.name: Samuel Giron
officers.bio: Samuel is a mechanical engineering student who joined AEC a year ago and quickly became Flight Systems Hardware Lead for the CUASC drone team. He plans to transfer to Cal Poly Pomona next year. As Co-President, his goal is to grow club membership and connect students with hands-on engineering opportunities.

officers.name: Aaron Burke
officers.bio: Manages the club budget, fundraising, and competition travel funding. Electrical engineering transfer student.

officers.name: Jane Nguyen
officers.bio: Jane is an Electrical Engineering student planning to transfer in Spring 2027. Through AEC's CUASC autonomous UAV project, she found a community for turning classroom knowledge into real, hands-on work. As Secretary, her vision is to expand hands-on projects and industry connections for students of every experience level.

officers.name: Mary Michael
officers.bio: Mary is a third-year Aerospace Engineering student who has been an AEC member since Fall 2025 and plans to transfer after Spring 2027. As Member Coordinator, her vision is to build a close-knit community where students connect over shared interests, collaborate on projects, and form lasting friendships.
